purpose: Correction/clarification of a contradiction inside the parent entry's description field.
contradiction_in_parent_entry: The parent description opens with the literal words 'PRE-REGISTERED FALSIFIER FIRED' and then immediately continues '(falsifier_fired=false means it did NOT fire)'. Both cannot be read as written. The field value in the JSON is falsifier_fired=false.

correct_reading.what_the_falsifier_was: Coverage identical across conventions within CI => the radius-form convention is cosmetic for coverage and the ~11% gap carries no coverage implication.
correct_reading.what_was_observed: Coverage is NOT identical across conventions. Every computable-vs-computable paired coverage-difference CI excludes zero.
correct_reading.meaning_of_that_boolean: falsifier_fired=false means the falsified proposition (identical coverage / cosmetic convention) was NOT supported. It does NOT mean 'nothing happened'. The convention is NOT cosmetic for coverage.
correct_reading.plain_sentence: The falsifier did not fire. The convention affects coverage: the radius form is not cosmetic.

on_the_number_11_percent.note: No tested pairing reproduces the recorded ~11.39% on these 1000 replicates. The qualitative claim (forms differ, not interchangeable) is confirmed and if anything understated; the specific percentage is not reproduced and should not be restated as reproduced.

oracle_caveat: sym_pooled, one_sided_pooled and uncentred_pooled use the realised D_rep distribution and therefore TRUE_TV; their coverage is near-target by construction and must never be cited as an achievable coverage. Only normal_theory_per_rep and sym_bootstrap_per_rep are computable per-replicate coverage measurements. NOTE: this restriction is now encoded in the parent rule string, which is why the corrected flag is true.
why_this_note_exists: The manifest is generated and cannot be hand-edited from an Agent session, and re-registering would create a suffixed duplicate rather than a correction. This sibling note is therefore the correction of record.
status: SUPERSEDED 2026-09-20 by the Director: the parent artifact’s falsifier flag and rule string were corrected in place. This note is retained for history; its "did_the_falsifier_fire" section no longer describes the parent.

correction_2026_09_20.what_changed: The parent JSON originally carried falsifier_fired=false alongside the rule "fired iff at least one paired 95% CI excludes zero". Those are inconsistent: 8 of the 10 paired differences have CIs excluding zero. The parent was corrected to falsifier_fired=true with a rule string that names the oracle restriction actually applied, and both prior values were preserved under key `falsifier_flag_correction`.
correction_2026_09_20.pairs_excluding_zero: 8 of 10 total; 1 of 1 among computable-only pairs
correction_2026_09_20.why_it_mattered: A false-negative flag beside a rule it does not satisfy is the "summary field is a claim, not an observation" failure this project has logged before. A later reader would have concluded no coverage difference exists, which is the opposite of the finding.
correction_2026_09_20.underlying_numbers: UNCHANGED. Only the flag and the rule text were corrected.
correction_2026_09_20.caught_by: independent review, not by the producing run.
